Convert to bit64's integer64

Source: R/engines.R
as_integer64.Rd

as_integer64() returns the values as a plain bit64 integer64, for code that checks the class exactly. int64 already has bit64's storage, so for it only the class changes; the other types convert first, exactly or to NA with a warning of class zuint_cast_warning. bit64 itself is not needed.

Usage

as_integer64(x)

Arguments

x

A zuint vector or a bit64 integer64.

Value

An integer64 vector the length of x, with its names.

Details

The other direction is int64(), which on an integer64 likewise only swaps the class.

Examples

y <- as_integer64(int64("9007199254740993"))
class(y)
#> [1] "integer64"
int64(y)
#> <int64[1]>
#> [1] 9007199254740993
